blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Video editing has advanced substantially in recent years, with methods increasingly accounting for the visual consequences of edits, such as changes to shadows and occlusions. However, the physical consequences of edits, including changes to subsequent motion and interactions, remain less explored.
We formulate this problem as physical counterfactual video editing (PCVE), which aims to generate a counterfactual video depicting the resulting motion and interactions given a source video, a physical edit, and its execution frame.
PCVE is challenging because it requires understanding scene physics and inferring the downstream motion and interactions induced by a physical intervention, while paired factual and counterfactual data and dedicated evaluation metrics are lacking.
We introduce VideoPhysEdit , a new training-free pipeline for PCVE in rigid-body scenes. It makes physical reasoning explicit through a novel physical scene reconstruction method that recovers a scene reproducing the observed motion and interactions under simulation, enabling the pipeline to apply physical edits as interventions and use the resulting trajectories to guide counterfactual video generation.
We further construct PCVE-RigidBench , a synthetic benchmark with paired source and counterfactual target videos and physical ground truth, and introduce the Physical Edit Score.
VideoPhysEdit achieves substantially higher physical edit accuracy than open-source methods and commercial models while maintaining competitive visual fidelity. Its Physical Edit Score is 0.376, the only positive score among the compared methods. Qualitative comparisons on real videos further show that VideoPhysEdit applies to real-world scenes and better depicts the downstream motion and interactions induced by the edits than the compared methods.
blocks.zh:
近年来,视频编辑工作取得了很大进展,各种方法越来越多地考虑到编辑的视觉后果,如阴影和隐蔽的变化。 然而,编辑的物理后果,包括后来的运动和互动的变化,仍然没有那么深入。
我们把这个问题发展成物理反事实视频编辑(PCVE), 目的是生成一个反事实视频, 描述由此产生的运动和互动,
PCVE具有挑战性,因为它需要了解场景物理学,并推断物理干预引起的下游运动和相互作用,同时缺乏对事实和反事实数据的配对和专用的评价指标。
我们介绍VideoPhysEdit, 这是PCVE在硬体场景中的新培训免费管道。 它通过一种新颖的物理场景重建方法使物理推理明确化,恢复一个场景在模拟中复制所观测到的运动和相互作用,使管道能够应用物理编辑作为干预,并利用由此产生的轨迹来引导反事实视频生成.
我们进一步构建了 PCVE-Rigid Bench, 一个合成基准 配对源和反事实 目标视频和物理地面真相, 并引入物理编辑分数。
视频 PhysEdit在保持竞争性视觉忠诚的同时,比开源方法和商业模型实现显著更高的物理编辑精度. 它的物理编辑分数为0.376,是比较方法中唯一的正分. 对真实视频的定性比较进一步显示,VideoPhysEdit适用于真实世界的场景,比比较方法更能描绘编辑所引发的下游运动和互动.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Modern video editing methods support diverse content modifications [ 44 , 16 , 58 , 38 , 23 ] and increasingly account for visual consequences, such as changes to shadows [ 35 , 30 ] , reflections [ 29 ] , and occlusions [ 28 ] . Yet an edit may also have physical consequences, including changes to subsequent motion and interactions. As illustrated in Figure , inserting an object can introduce new collisions, changing restitution can alter rebound motion, and removing an object can eliminate downstream interactions.
blocks.zh: 现代视频编辑方法支持不同内容的修改[44,16,58,38,23],并越来越多地考虑到视觉后果,如对阴影的修改[35,30],反射[29],以及隐含[28]. 然而,编辑也可能产生物理后果,包括改变随后的运动和互动。 如图所示,插入一个物体可以引入新的碰撞,改变还原可以改变反弹运动,删除一个物体可以消除下游的相互作用.

blocks.en: Prior work has explored physics-aware video editing, but existing methods typically support only a limited range of edits [ 42 ] or rely on predefined physical models or external 3D proxies [ 5 , 20 ] . To our knowledge, diverse physical interventions and their consequences for subsequent motion and interactions remain less explored as a unified video editing task.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作探索了物理意识视频编辑,但现有方法一般只支持有限的编辑范围[42],或依靠预先定义的物理模型或外部的3D代理[5,20]. 据我们所知,作为统一的视频编辑任务,各种物理干预及其对随后的行动和互动的影响仍然较少得到探讨。

blocks.en: If we treat the scene evolution recorded in the source video as factual, another possible evolution induced by changes to scene composition, object states, or physical parameters constitutes a physical counterfactual. We refer to this problem as physical counterfactual video editing (PCVE). We consider three types of physical edits: inserting or removing an object, modifying an object’s motion state, and altering physical parameters of an object or the scene. Executing such an edit at a specified frame constitutes a physical intervention. Given a source video, a physical edit, and its execution frame, the task is to produce a counterfactual video that preserves the factual history before the intervention and evolves thereafter under the altered physical conditions.
blocks.zh: 如果我们将源视频中记录的场景演化视为事实,由场景组成变化,物体状态或物理参数引起的另一种可能演化构成物理反事实. 我们将此问题称为物理反事实视频编辑(PCVE). 我们考虑三种类型的物理编辑:插入或删除对象,修改对象的运动状态,以及改变对象或场景的物理参数. 在指定框架执行这种编辑构成实际干预。 鉴于一个源视频,一个物理编辑,以及其执行框架,任务是制作一个反事实视频,在干预之前保留事实历史,然后在改变的物理条件下演变.

blocks.en: This task presents two main challenges. First, physical counterfactual video editing requires understanding scene physics and inferring the downstream motion and interactions induced by a physical intervention. Generative video editing methods are powerful at synthesizing realistic visual content, but they rely primarily on information encoded in image and video representations, limiting their ability to perform such physical reasoning. Second, paired factual and counterfactual data for supervision and evaluation are not naturally available, and dedicated metrics for physical editing are lacking. A video records only the factual evolution and cannot reveal the counterfactual evolution under an alternative intervention, while conventional video editing metrics do not measure whether the resulting motion and interactions are physically correct.
blocks.zh: 这项任务提出了两个主要挑战。 首先,物理反事实视频编辑需要理解场景物理,并推断物理干预引发的下游运动和相互作用. 基因视频编辑方法在合成现实视觉内容方面很强大,但它们主要依靠在图像和视频表现中编码的信息,限制了他们进行这种物理推理的能力. 第二,无法自然地获得用于监督和评价的事实和反事实的配对数据,而且缺乏用于物理编辑的专门指标。 视频只记录事实演化,无法在替代干预下揭示反事实演化,而常规的视频编辑度量标准则不能衡量由此产生的运动和互动在物理上是否正确.

blocks.en: We introduce VideoPhysEdit , a new training-free pipeline for physical counterfactual video editing in rigid-body scenes. It makes physical reasoning explicit through a novel physical scene reconstruction method that organizes source video observations into stable intervals and transition episodes, combines geometric and rigid-body constraints to initialize object states and physical parameters, and refines them to recover a physical scene whose simulation reproduces the observed motion and interactions. VideoPhysEdit then grounds the physical edit in this scene, applies it as an intervention, and uses the resulting trajectories to guide counterfactual video generation.
blocks.zh: 我们推出VideoPhysEdit, 一个新的免费培训管道, 它通过一种新颖的物理场景重建方法使物理推理明确化,将源视频观测组织为稳定的间隔和过渡事件,结合几何学和刚性-身体约束来初始化物体状态和物理参数,并对其进行精炼以恢复模拟复制所观察到的运动和相互作用的物理场景. 视频 PhysEdit然后将物理编辑放入本场景,作为干预应用,并使用由此产生的轨迹指导反事实视频生成.

blocks.en: To address the lack of paired factual and counterfactual data and dedicated evaluation metrics, we construct PCVE-RigidBench , which provides paired source and counterfactual target videos with physical ground truth, and introduce the Physical Edit Score to measure the reduction in trajectory error against the counterfactual target relative to the unchanged source video. On PCVE-RigidBench, VideoPhysEdit achieves substantially higher physical edit accuracy than open-source methods and commercial models, including Seedance 2.5 [ 8 ] and MiniMax H3 [ 41 ] , while maintaining competitive visual fidelity. Its Physical Edit Score is 0.376, the only positive score among the compared methods, and it reduces trajectory error by 54.0% relative to the strongest competing method. Qualitative comparisons on real videos further show that VideoPhysEdit applies to real-world scenes and better depicts the downstream motion and interactions induced by the edits than the compared methods.
blocks.zh: 为了解决缺乏对齐的事实和反事实数据以及专用的评价度量衡的问题,我们构建了PCVE-Rigid Bench ,它提供了配对的源和反事实目标视频,具有物理地面真实性,并引入了物理编辑分数,以比照未变的源视频来测量反事实目标轨迹误差的减少. 在PCVE-Rigid Bench上,视频 PhysEdit比开源方法和商业模型,包括Speedance 2.5 [8]和MiniMax H3 [41],实现了显著更高的物理编辑精度,同时保持了竞争性的视觉忠诚. 它的物理编辑分数为0.376,是比较方法中唯一的正分,相对于最强竞争方法,它将轨迹误差减少54.0%. 对真实视频的定性比较进一步显示,VideoPhysEdit适用于真实世界的场景,比比较方法更能描绘编辑所引发的下游运动和互动.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: (1) We formulate PCVE as a unified task for physical interventions and downstream consequences. (2) We introduce VideoPhysEdit, a new training-free pipeline featuring a novel physical scene reconstruction method. (3) We construct PCVE-RigidBench with paired factual and counterfactual data and physical ground truth, and introduce the Physical Edit Score. Extensive quantitative evaluations demonstrate substantial improvements in physical edit accuracy, while qualitative results show applicability to real-world videos.
blocks.zh: 我们的捐款如下: (1) 我们制定PCVE,作为进行物理干预和下游后果的统一任务。 (2)我们推出VideoPhysEdit,这是一条新的无培训管道,以全新的物理场景重建方法为特色. (3)我们构建了PCVE-Rigid Bench,配对的事实和反事实数据以及物理地面真相,并引入物理编辑分数. 广泛的定量评价表明,物理编辑准确性大有提高,而质量结果显示适用于现实世界的视频。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Physics-Aware Video Editing
blocks.zh: 2.1 物理-智能视频编辑

blocks.en: Video editing methods typically build on pretrained image or video generative models, combining attention or feature reuse [ 44 , 16 , 58 , 52 , 24 , 28 , 51 ] with cross-frame constraints and editable masks or layers [ 30 , 40 , 22 , 14 , 29 , 31 ] to maintain visual quality and temporal consistency. However, these methods primarily target visual content and spatiotemporal structure, rather than the physical changes caused by an edit and their downstream consequences. Although some methods also allow users to specify motion changes [ 54 , 43 , 7 , 31 ] , they control motion primarily by prescribing target trajectories, rather than enabling edits to upstream factors such as scene composition, object states, or physical parameters.
blocks.zh: 视频编辑方法一般以预修的图像或视频基因模型为基础,结合注意或特征再利用[44,16,58,52,24,28,51]与跨框约束和可编辑口罩或层[30,40,22,14,29,31],以保持视觉质量和时间一致性. 然而,这些方法主要针对视觉内容和瞬间结构,而不是编辑引起的物理变化及其下游后果. 尽管有些方法也允许用户指定运动变化[54,43,7,31],但它们主要通过规定目标轨迹来控制运动,而不是允许编辑到场景组成,物体状态,或物理参数等上游因素.

blocks.en: Physics-aware video editing methods incorporate physical models or reasoning to account for these consequences. Bazin et al. [5] fit a predefined physical simulation to the motion observed in a source video and allow users to edit its physical parameters. Calipso [ 20 ] instead performs physical manipulations on external CAD proxies and transfers the results back to video. Both produce physics-based edits but depend on a predefined physical model and additional 3D information, respectively. AutoVFX [ 21 ] creates physically grounded visual effects from a reconstructed static 3D scene using programs generated by a large language model, but relies on a multi-view capture of the static scene. VOID [ 42 ] is the closest recent method to our setting. It uses a VLM to infer which objects and image regions may be affected by target removal and encodes them as 2D masks that guide a video diffusion model to generate the resulting downstream changes. To obtain counterfactual supervision, it constructs paired synthetic removal data using Kubric [ 17 ] and HUMOTO [ 37 ] . However, VOID specializes in object removal: its intervention representation and paired supervision do not cover object insertion, motion state modification, or physical parameter editing. In contrast, PCVE defines a unified setting for inferring the downstream consequences of diverse physical interventions from motion and interactions observed in a source video.
blocks.zh: 物理意识的视频编辑方法包含了物理模型或推理来解释这些后果. 巴津等译. [5] 将预定义的物理模拟与源视频中观察到的运动相匹配,并允许用户编辑其物理参数. Calipso [20] 转而对外部 CAD 代理进行物理操纵,并将结果转回视频. 两者都产生基于物理的编辑,但分别依赖于预先定义的物理模型和额外的3D信息. AutoVFX [21] 利用大型语言模型生成的程序,从一个重建的静态3D场景中创建了物理基础的视觉效果,但依赖于对静态场景的多视图捕捉. VOID [42] 是最近最接近我们设定的方法. 它使用一个VLM来推断哪些物体和图像区域可能受到目标清除的影响,并将它们编码为2D口罩,引导视频传播模型生成由此产生的下游变化. 为了获得反事实监督,它使用Kubric[17]和HUMOTO[37]构建配对合成清除数据. 然而,VOID专门从事对象清除:其干预表现和配对监督不涵盖对象插入,运动状态修改,或物理参数编辑. 相比之下,PCVE定义了一种统一的环境,从源视频中观察到的运动和互动推断出各种物理干预的下游后果.

blocks.en: 2.2 4D Reconstruction and Physical Modeling
blocks.zh: 2.2 4D 重建和物理建模

blocks.en: Several lines of work underpin physical scene reconstruction from video. DreamScene4D [ 12 ] , GFlow [ 57 ] , Shape of Motion [ 56 ] , and DyST [ 50 ] recover scene geometry and motion. Beyond geometry and motion, PPR [ 60 ] , NeuPhysics [ 45 ] , and the work of Gao et al. [15] incorporate physical models to recover physical properties or dynamics from observed motion. These methods recover observed geometry, motion, or latent physical quantities, but do not generally target an executable physical scene model that reproduces multi-object motion and contact through simulation.
blocks.zh: 几条工作线支撑着从视频中重建物理场景. DreamScene4D [12],GFlow [57],运动形状 [56],DyST [50] 恢复场景几何和运动. 超越几何与运动,PPR[60],NeuPhysics[45],以及高等人的作品. [15] 包含物理模型,从观测到的运动中恢复物理性质或动力学. 这些方法可以回收观测到的几何,运动,或潜在物理量,但一般不针对一个可执行的物理场景模型,通过模拟复制多物体运动和接触.

blocks.en: Recent work explores constructing simulation-ready scene representations from video. Vid2Sim [ 9 ] and MonoPhysics [ 47 ] recover appearance, geometry, and physical parameters for deformable object simulation, while MOSIV [ 34 ] uses differentiable simulation to identify material parameters in multi-object systems from multi-view observations. From a monocular video, OVOW [ 10 ] recovers an instance-level physical 4D scene with object geometry, motion, support, and contact information, but represents motion using recovered trajectories or vertex deformations instead of an identified dynamical model that reproduces it through simulation. Δ \Delta YNAMICS [ 26 ] uses a VLM to infer a rigid-body configuration that reproduces the observed motion. However, it is trained on synthetic simulations and assumes a simple ground-plane environment without reconstructing scene-specific support and collision geometry. PhysMind [ 59 ] targets physical reasoning, fitting analytic dynamics and latent physical parameters to recovered 3D trajectories to construct an executable world. VideoPhysEdit instead refines the reconstructed physical scene by matching simulated and observed masks, obtaining the geometric and temporal alignment needed for counterfactual video generation.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作探索从视频中构建模拟准备场景表现. Vid2Sim [9] 和 MonoPhysics [47] 恢复外观,几何,以及可变形物体模拟的物理参数,而MOSIV [34] 则使用不同的模拟,从多视点观测中识别多天体系统中的物质参数. OVOW[10]从单视视频中回收一个带有物体几何,运动,支持,和联系信息的实例级物理4D场景,但代表运动的是使用恢复的轨迹或顶点变形,而不是通过模拟复制的已识别的动态模型. \\Delta YNAMICS [26] 使用 VLM 推断出一个复制被观测到的运动的刚性-身体配置. 然而,它接受了合成模拟的培训,并假设了一个简单的地面飞机环境,而不重建场景特定支持和碰撞几何. PhysMind [59] 瞄准物理推理,配置分析动力学和潜在物理参数以恢复3D轨迹以构建可执行的世界. 视频 相反,PhysEdit通过匹配模拟和观测到的口罩来完善重建后的物理场景,获得反事实视频生成所需的几何和时间对齐.

blocks.en: 2.3 Physical Video Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.3 实体视频基准

blocks.en: Recent benchmarks evaluate video generation and editing from complementary perspectives on physical realism and edit fidelity. VideoPhy [ 3 ] , VideoPhy-2 [ 4 ] , PhyGenBench [ 39 ] , T2VPhysBench [ 19 ] , and PhyWorldBench [ 18 ] evaluate physical commonsense or adherence to physical laws in text-to-video generation. FiVE-Bench [ 32 ] evaluates instruction following and visual quality in fine-grained video editing, while PVIR [ 33 ] focuses on removal-induced visual effects, such as changes in shadows and reflections. CRONOS [ 6 ] evaluates video predictions under counterfactual changes in viewpoint, scene, object appearance, or object category while retaining the same physical event type. PCVE-RigidBench instead directly intervenes on scene composition, object states, or physical parameters and evaluates the resulting motion and interactions against counterfactual target videos and physical ground truth.
blocks.zh: 最近的基准从对实体现实主义的补充角度评价录像制作和编辑,并编辑忠诚度。 视频 Phy [3],视频 Phy-2 [4],PhyGen Bench [39],T2VPhys Bench [19],以及PhyWorld Bench [18] 在文本到视频生成中评价物理常识或遵守物理定律的情况. FiVE-Bench [32] 在精致的视频编辑中评价了后续指示和视觉质量,而PVIR [33] 则侧重于去除引起的视觉效果,如阴影和反射的变化. CRONOS [6] 在对视,场景,对象外观或对象类的反事实变化下评价视频预测,同时保留相同的物理事件类型. PCVE-Rigid Bench转而直接干预现场组成,物体状态,或物理参数,并评价由此产生的运动和相互作用与反事实目标视频和物理地面真实性.

blocks.en: 3.2 VideoPhysEdit Overview
blocks.zh: 3.2 视频 物理编辑概览

blocks.en: Figure 1 presents the VideoPhysEdit pipeline. Its seven numbered modules are referred to as Stages 1–7 in the experiments and appendix. Given a source video, a physical edit, and its execution frame, VideoPhysEdit first identifies and tracks the objects involved in the observed motion and interactions, producing framewise masks with consistent identities. It then organizes the observed motion into stable intervals and transition episodes and reconstructs scene geometry and a 6DoF motion prior in a shared world coordinate system. Using the motion prior, support relations, and rigid-body constraints, it initializes the object states and physical parameters governing motion and contact, and further optimizes the initial states, physical parameters, and collision proxies so that the simulated motion and interactions match the observations (Section 3.3 ). Finally, it grounds the physical edit in the reconstructed scene, applies it at t e t_{e} as a physical intervention, and uses the simulated counterfactual trajectories together with an edited reference image to guide counterfactual video generation (Section 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: 图1显示了视频物理编辑管道。 它的七个编号模块在实验和附录中被称为第1-7阶段. 由于一个源视频,一个物理编辑,及其执行框架,VideosPhysEdit首先识别和跟踪被观测到的运动和互动中涉及的物体,生成具有一致身份的帧口罩. 然后它将观测到的运动组织成稳定的间隔和过渡事件,并重建场景几何和在共享的世界坐标系统之前的6DoF运动. 利用运动前,支持关系,和刚性体约束,它初始化了物体状态和支配运动和接触的物理参数,并进一步优化了初始状态,物理参数,以及碰撞代位,使模拟运动和相互作用与观测结果相匹配(第3.3节). 最后,它将物理编辑置于重建的场景中,作为物理干预应用在t e t_{e},并使用模拟反事实轨迹与编辑后的参考图像来指导反事实视频生成(第3.4节).

blocks.en: Given a source video and a physical edit, a vision-language model uses uniformly sampled video frames and the edit description to identify the categories of objects involved in the observed motion and interactions. An open-vocabulary object detector then locates instances of these categories in the first frame, with each instance assigned an object identity i i . The detected bounding boxes initialize a video object segmentation model, which propagates per-object masks M i , t M_{i,t} through the video while maintaining consistent identities across frames. These masks provide observations for subsequent scene reconstruction and physical inversion.

To provide reliable references for 3D reconstruction, we select a canonical frame as the reference for the shared world coordinate system and one motion anchor frame for each stable interval. Appendix A.1 provides algorithmic details for motion modeling and frame selection.

blocks.en: Physical inversion estimates the initial states and physical parameters that make the reconstructed scene reproduce the observed motion and interactions under simulation. We construct collision proxies from the reconstructed geometry and derive rigid-body constraints from the support relations and 6DoF motion prior. Stable intervals constrain force balance, friction, rolling, and energy, while contact events constrain momentum balance, restitution, and friction. We solve these constraints within physically valid parameter ranges, using explicit priors only for quantities that the observations do not determine. This initializes η = ( Θ , 𝐬 1 , 𝒢 col ) \eta=(\Theta,\mathbf{s}_{1},\mathcal{G}^{\mathrm{col}}) .

blocks.en: 3.4 Physical Intervention and Counterfactual Video Generation
blocks.zh: 3.4 物理干预和反事实视频生成

blocks.en: We parse the physical edit instruction into a structured Add, Delete, or Set operation, using templates for quantitative benchmark instructions and a vision-language model for other requests. We bind the instruction’s object references to the persistent identities recovered from the source video and resolve relative quantities and spatial references in the reconstructed scene. At the execution frame t e t_{e} , we apply the parsed operation to the factual state and simulate the scene’s subsequent evolution to obtain the counterfactual state sequence. We then convert the simulated counterfactual motion into projected point trajectories and prepare an edited reference image at the execution frame, providing motion and appearance controls for counterfactual video generation. The intervention procedure is described in Appendix A.5 .
blocks.zh: 我们将物理编辑指令分为结构化的添加、删除或设置操作,使用量化基准指令模板和其他请求的视觉语言模型。 校对:Soup 并模拟现场随后的演化过程, 然后将模拟反事实运动转换成预测点轨迹,并在执行框上准备一个经过编辑的参考图像,为反事实视频生成提供运动和外观控制. 干预程序见附录A.5。

blocks.en: Finally, we use a pretrained video generation model conditioned on the projected point trajectories, edited reference image, and a scene prompt to generate the counterfactual continuation. Further details of video generation are given in Appendix A.6 .
blocks.zh: 最后,我们使用一个预先训练的视频生成模型,以预测的点轨迹为条件,经过编辑的参考图像,以及一个场景提示来生成反事实续作. 录像制作的进一步详情见附录A.6。

blocks.en: 4 PCVE-RigidBench
blocks.zh: 4个PCVE-Rigid Bench

blocks.en: To evaluate the downstream consequences of physical edits, we construct PCVE-RigidBench with 20 synthetic rigid-body scenes spanning impacts, rebounds, rolling, sliding, falls, and collision chains. We simulate each source evolution and its counterfactual evolutions in PyBullet and render the resulting videos in Blender. The benchmark contains 129 editing tasks, each pairing a source video and a physical edit with a counterfactual target video and corresponding physical ground truth. The benchmark covers object insertion and removal and changes to initial velocity, mass, friction, or restitution. Each task applies the intervention either at the first frame or partway through the video and provides two descriptions: a quantitative description specifying its execution frame and numerical or spatial change, and a qualitative description giving its direction and coarse timing.
blocks.zh: 为了评估物理编辑的下游后果, 我们构建了PCVE-Rigid Bench 20个合成的硬体场景, 跨越撞击,反弹,滚动,滑动,坠落,和碰撞链。 我们在PyBullet中模拟每个源进化及其反事实进化,并在Blender中渲染由此产生的视频. 基准包含129项编辑任务,每个任务将一个源视频和物理编辑配对一个反事实目标视频和相应的物理地面真相. 基准包括物体插入和清除以及改变初始速度、质量、摩擦或还原。 每项任务要么在第一帧,要么在视频中部分地应用干预,并提供两种描述:说明其执行框架和数字或空间变化的量化描述,以及说明其方向和粗糙时间的定性描述.

blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: VideoPhysEdit uses Qwen3-VL [ 2 ] to parse natural language physical edits and identify the referenced objects in the source video. Grounding DINO [ 36 ] and SAM 2 [ 46 ] provide object observations, CoTracker3 [ 27 ] provides point tracks, and VGGT [ 55 ] with SuperGlue [ 49 ] reconstructs the scene. PyBullet [ 13 ] simulates the observed and counterfactual motion. ObjectClear [ 61 ] prepares reference images for Delete operations, while Insert Anything [ 53 ] and Cube3D [ 48 ] provide appearance and geometry for inserted objects. Wan-Move [ 11 ] generates the counterfactual video. All pretrained components use released checkpoints. Model variants and generation settings are provided in Appendix C.1.1 .
blocks.zh: VideoPhysEdit使用Qune3-VL[2]来解析自然语言物理编辑,并识别源视频中的引用对象. 地面DINO [36]和SAM 2 [46]提供物体观测,CoTracker3 [27]提供点轨,VGGT [55]与SuperGlue [49]重建现场. PyBullet [13] 模拟观测到的反事实运动. ObjectClear [61] 为删除操作准备参考图像,同时插入 Anything [53] 和 Cube3D [48] 为插入对象提供外观和几何. Wan-Move [11] 生成反事实视频. 所有经过预先训练的部件都使用已放行的检查站。 模式变体和生成设置载于附录C.1.1。

blocks.en: We compare VideoPhysEdit with two open-source methods, VACE [ 25 ] and Ditto [ 1 ] , and two commercial models, MiniMax H3 [ 41 ] and Seedance 2.5 [ 8 ] . Each method receives the same source video and quantitative English edit instruction. For object removal, we additionally compare with VOID [ 42 ] . We include the unchanged source video as the No edit baseline. For physical edit accuracy, we report Trajectory Error (TE), Physical Edit Score (PES), and Mask IoU. For visual fidelity, we report PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, CLIP image similarity, and FVD. Appendix B provides metric definitions and aggregation details.
blocks.zh: 我们比较视频 VACE [25]和Ditto [1],以及MiniMax H3 [41] 和种子2.5 [8]两种商业模式的开源方式。 每种方法都得到相同的源视频和量化英语编辑指令. 关于物体清除,我们与VOID[42]进行额外的比较. 我们把未修改的源视频作为 " 不编辑 " 基线。 关于物理编辑准确性,我们报告轨迹错误(TE)、物理编辑分数(PES)和Mask IoU。 关于视觉忠诚,我们报告PSNR,SSIM,LPIPS,CLIP图像相似性,以及FVD. 附 录 B提供了衡量定义和汇总细节。

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results on PCVE-RigidBench
blocks.zh: 5.2 关于PCVE-Rigid Bench的主要结果

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that VideoPhysEdit achieves the best physical edit accuracy among the evaluated methods. It reduces TE by 54.0% relative to the strongest competing method, achieves the highest Mask IoU and PES, and is the only method with a positive PES. For other affected objects, whose motion changes as a consequence of the edit, VideoPhysEdit is again the only method with a positive PES, reaching 0.276, as shown in Appendix Table 9 . This shows that the method more accurately depicts the changes in other objects’ motion caused by the edit. For visual fidelity, VideoPhysEdit remains close to Seedance 2.5 in PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and CLIP similarity while achieving the best FVD. Together, these results show that VideoPhysEdit produces substantially more accurate physical edits while retaining comparable visual fidelity.
blocks.zh: 表1显示视频 PhysEdit在被评价方法中实现了最好的物理编辑精度. 相对于最强竞争方法,它将TE减少了54.0%,实现了最高的Mask IoU和PES,也是唯一一个具有正PES的方法. 对于由于编辑而导致运动变化的其他受影响物体,VideoPhysEdit再次是PES正值的唯一方法,达到0.276,见附录表9。 这表明该方法更准确地描绘了编辑导致的其他物体运动的变化. 对于视觉忠诚,VideoPhysEdit在PSNR,SSIM,LPIPS,和CLIP的相似性上仍然接近于Speedance 2.5,同时实现了最好的FVD. 这些结果表明,VideoPhysEdit在保持可比较的视觉忠贞性的同时,能产生更精确的物理编辑.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 2 , VideoPhysEdit follows the requested changes in motion and interaction while preserving the source scene. Increasing the large marble’s mass changes the motion of both marbles after impact, and reducing the toy car’s initial speed prevents its later collision with the ball. Edits to projectile velocity and object removal before a collision further demonstrate applicability to real videos. In comparison, the other methods more often retain the source motion or alter the scene appearance.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,视频 PhysEdit在保留源场景的同时,跟踪运动和互动中所要求的变化. 增加大理石的质量会改变撞击后两个大理石的运动,减少玩具车的初始速度会防止它后来与球碰撞. 在碰撞进一步证明适用于真实视频之前,编辑以投射速度和物体清除。 相比之下,其他方法更常保留源动或改变场景外观.

blocks.en: We further include VOID, a method designed specifically for object removal, in the comparison on the object removal tasks in PCVE-RigidBench. As shown in Table 2 , VideoPhysEdit achieves the best physical edit accuracy. It reduces TE by 37.0% relative to VOID and obtains the highest PES and Mask IoU. VOID obtains the highest PSNR, consistent with its preservation of unaffected source regions and restriction of generation to the removed object and regions predicted to change. VideoPhysEdit achieves the best SSIM and FVD, while its LPIPS and CLIP similarity remain competitive. Appendix C.6 provides qualitative comparisons with VOID on two PCVE-RigidBench removal tasks and two real collision videos. VideoPhysEdit therefore removes the requested objects more accurately and reproduces their effects on subsequent motion while preserving visual quality.

blocks.en: Taken together, these results show that visually plausible video generation alone does not ensure a successful physical edit. The comparison methods infer the counterfactual evolution directly from the source video and instruction, and their outputs often retain the source motion or miss later effects of the edit. Explicitly describing the downstream consequences in the instruction does not yield consistent improvements (Appendix C.5 ). This suggests that explicitly grounding the physical intervention in an executable physical scene whose simulation reproduces the observed motion and interactions provides a more reliable basis for physical counterfactual video editing than inferring the intervention’s consequences implicitly.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,仅凭视似可信的视频生成并不能确保物理编辑取得成功。 比较方法直接从源视频和指令推断出反事实演化,其产出往往保留源动或错过编辑的后期效果. 指令中明确描述下游后果并不能产生一致的改进(附录C.5 )。 这表明,把物理干预明确置于可执行的物理场景中,其模拟复制了观察到的运动和相互作用,为物理反事实视频编辑提供了比暗示干预的后果更可靠的依据。

blocks.en: 5.3 Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 分析

blocks.en: We analyze the intermediate outputs to determine how reconstruction accuracy propagates to counterfactual trajectories and the final video. As shown in Table 3 , the Stage 3 canonical and motion anchor scenes recover the source scene, and the Stage 4 motion prior maintains this alignment over the complete sequence. Stage 5 then fits one physical rollout to the observed motion. Simulation search and final refinement improve both this factual rollout and the Stage 6 counterfactual trajectories relative to the calibrated initialization. Stage 7 preserves the resulting motion: on matched objects and frames, TE remains nearly unchanged, while PES and Mask IoU improve slightly. These results connect accurate reconstruction of the source video to accurate counterfactual trajectories and show that video generation primarily restores the source appearance.
blocks.zh: 我们分析中间产出,以确定重建的准确性如何传播反事实轨迹和最后的视频。 如表3所示,第3阶段的舟体和运动锚地场景恢复了源场景,第4阶段的运动在之前维持了这种对齐的完整序列. 第5阶段则与观测到的运动相匹配。 模拟搜索和最后的改进既改进了这一实际推出,也改进了与校准初始化有关的第6阶段反事实轨迹。 第七阶段保留了由此产生的运动:在匹配的物体和框架上,TE几乎保持不变,而PES和Mask IoU则略有改进. 这些结果将源视频的准确重建与准确的反事实轨迹联系起来,并表明视频生成主要恢复源的外观.

blocks.en: We further analyze the pipeline’s robustness to incomplete or ambiguous observations. The pipeline resolves uncertainty progressively across stages rather than relying on any single observation. Stage 3 combines object geometry, support relations, and motion anchor frames to recover a consistent scene, while Stages 4 and 5 use evidence across time to reconstruct missing motion and distinguish candidate simulations. Stage 7 then uses adaptive temporal scaling and the interaction ROI to follow fast trajectories and preserve small objects during contact. Together, these mechanisms reduce the influence of missing or ambiguous evidence in any single frame on the final edit. Section C.2.2 provides the complete results and examples.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步分析输油管的稳健性, 管道逐步解决各阶段的不确定性,而不是依靠任何单一的观察。 第3阶段结合物体几何,支持关系,和运动锚框来恢复一致的场景,而第4阶段和第5阶段则使用跨时间的证据来重建缺失的运动,区分候选模拟. 第七阶段然后使用适应性时间缩放和相互作用ROI来跟踪快速轨道,并在接触时保存小物体. 这些机制合在一起减少了任何单一框架中缺失或模糊的证据在最终编辑过程中的影响. C.2.2节提供了全部结果和实例。

blocks.en: Appendix C.2.3 examines boundary cases, including two scenes for which the pipeline produces no valid edited videos. Appendix C further reports pipeline analysis, the simulation search ablation, runtime and peak GPU memory, the effect of explicit downstream consequences, and additional visual results on PCVE-RigidBench and real videos.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we formulate physical counterfactual video editing as a unified task and introduce VideoPhysEdit, a training-free pipeline that reconstructs an executable physical scene and guides counterfactual video generation using simulated counterfactual trajectories. We also construct PCVE-RigidBench and introduce the Physical Edit Score. VideoPhysEdit achieves substantially higher physical edit accuracy than open-source methods and commercial models, while qualitative comparisons on real videos further show that it applies to real-world scenes and better depicts the downstream motion and interactions induced by the edits than the compared methods. Future work will explore camera motion, richer geometry, and physical models for articulated or actively controlled agents. More broadly, VideoPhysEdit establishes a framework for PCVE in which explicit physical reasoning guides visual generation, enabling video editing to change not only how a scene looks, but also what happens after a physical edit.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们制定物理反事实视频编辑作为统一的任务,并引入VideoPhysEdit,这是一个免费培训的管道,它重建了可执行物理场景,并用模拟反事实轨迹来引导反事实视频生成. 我们还构建了PCVE-Rigid Bench,并引入物理编辑分数. 视频 PhysEdit实现比开源方法和商业模型的物理编辑精度要高得多,而对真实视频的质量比较进一步表明,它适用于现实世界的场景,并且比比较方法更好地描绘编辑所引发的下游运动和互动. 今后的工作将探索相机运动,更丰富的几何学,以及用于表达或积极控制的物剂的物理模型. 更广泛的视频 PhysEdit为PCVE建立了一个框架,其中明确的物理推理指导视觉生成,使得视频编辑不仅可以改变一个场景的外观,还可以改变物理编辑后发生的事情.

blocks.en: Canonical and anchor scene reconstruction recovers geometry and support relations at the canonical frame, places the objects in the canonical scene, and then reconstructs an anchor scene for each motion anchor frame.
blocks.zh: 坎尼奇和锚地场重建恢复了几何学,并在坎尼奇框架支持关系,将物体放置在坎尼奇的场景中,然后为每个运动锚地框架重建一个锚地场景.

blocks.en: A.2.1 Canonical Geometry and Support Surfaces
blocks.zh: A.2.1 罐形几何和支助表面

blocks.en: The pretrained 3D reconstruction model estimates camera parameters and point clouds from the canonical frame and nearby frames. Object masks separate foreground points from the static background. Each object’s points are fitted with a sphere or box according to its category, and projecting the source image onto the fitted surface yields a textured visual mesh.
blocks.zh: 预先训练的3D重建模型估计了相机参数和点云从舟子框架和附近的框架. 物体口罩将前景点与静态背景分开. 每个物体的点都按其类别装有球体或盒子,将源图像投射到装配的表面,产生有纹理的视觉网格。

blocks.en: We extract static scene planes from the background point cloud and refine their finite boundaries using image outlines. Geometrically compatible fragments are repeatedly merged, and each merged plane is refitted to the union of its supporting 3D points. These planes establish the shared world coordinate system and provide candidate support surfaces. Upward-facing planar patches on reconstructed objects are also retained as support candidates for other objects, recording which object each patch belongs to. For each object, we select among static planes and other objects’ patches using nonpenetration, contact at the object’s lower surface, and coverage within the plane’s finite boundary. The median signed contact height h obs h_{\mathrm{obs}} determines the support height range used in placement.

Appearance is projected from the current image, and motion anchor frames coinciding with the canonical frame reuse its reconstruction. If the observed stable motion indicates that an object remains supported beyond the image boundary, we extend only support footprints truncated by that boundary. This yields geometrically consistent 3D anchor poses and support relations for motion fitting.

blocks.zh: A.3 重建前的动议

blocks.en: Motion prior reconstruction combines the stable intervals, transition episodes, and image observations with the canonical scene and anchor poses to estimate each object’s motion in the shared world coordinate system. Motion fitting uses the reconstructed object geometry and scale, and τ = ( t − t 0 ) / f \tau=(t-t_{0})/f converts frame indices to seconds at frame rate f f . blocks.en: Using the canonical and anchor scenes, we lift image observations into a common 3D reference. Image positions define camera rays, while anchor centers and point cloud tracks provide 3D positions weighted by confidence. When support is confirmed, we intersect the rays with the plane of center motion; otherwise, we fit the motion from the available depth and image evidence. We retain support hypotheses consistent with the recovered motion, including possible rotation about a contact line.

blocks.en: A.6 Counterfactual Video Generation

blocks.en: A pretrained video generation model takes the projected point trajectories, edited reference image, and scene prompt as conditions. Adaptive temporal scaling assigns model frames in proportion to projected displacement, interpolates the point trajectories on the expanded timeline, and maps the generated frames back to the source timeline. This changes neither the counterfactual motion nor the duration of the final video. Longer continuations use overlapping windows, with the final valid frame of each window becoming the reference for the next. We assemble the continuation I ^ t \widehat{I}_{t} by removing overlaps and padded tails. If the smaller object in a contacting pair has a projected diameter below 48 pixels, a fixed interaction region of interest (ROI) covers the complete interaction throughout the edited sequence. Within each generation window, we enlarge this region and blend the generated result into the full image, while using the full frame in all other cases.

blocks.en: Motion evaluation uses Grounding DINO [ 36 ] ( grounding-dino-tiny , box and text thresholds both 0.20) to locate objects from short descriptions of their appearance and SAM2.1 [ 46 ] (Hiera-L) to propagate their masks. The prediction, target, and source videos are tracked with the same descriptions, with visually identical objects sharing one description. Tracking both the prediction and the target video yields comparable mask centroids and avoids the discrepancy between a visible centroid and the simulated object origin during rotation. The tracked target centroid serves as the reference for the trajectory metrics.

blocks.en: For removal, correct absence after the execution frame has zero error, while an object that remains visible is penalized by its distance to the nearest image edge. For partway removal, frames before and after the execution frame are evaluated together, so both premature and failed removal are penalized. These errors contribute to TE and PES. blocks.en: B.4 Visual Fidelity

blocks.en: PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and CLIP image similarity are averaged over corresponding frames of the prediction and target videos. Each prediction is resized to the target resolution when necessary, and matching frame indices are compared over their common duration, including both the factual prefix and edited continuation when present. LPIPS uses AlexNet features, and CLIP image similarity uses OpenCLIP ViT-B/32 pretrained on LAION-2B ( laion2b_s34b_b79k ). FVD is computed once from the distributions of Kinetics-400 I3D features over the prediction and target video sets.
blocks.zh: PSNR,SSIM,LPIPS,以及CLIP图像的相似性均与预测和目标视频的相应帧相比平均. 每个预测都在必要时调整到目标分辨率,并按共同时间比较匹配框架指数,包括事实前缀和在场时的编辑续作。 LPIPS使用AlexNet特性,CLIP图像相似性使用LAION-2B(laion2b_s34b_b79k)上预训的OpenCLIP ViT-B/32. FVD从Kinetics-400 I3D特性在预测和目标视频集的发行量中计算一次.

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows that motion prior reconstruction usually preserves the alignment recovered from the anchor scenes while extending object poses across the full sequence. The largest losses occur during physical inversion in scenes with several contacts, including table_drop_collision , dining_chain , and air_hockey_chain . A small error in contact position or timing changes the outgoing velocity and displaces every subsequent state. Scenes with simpler contact sequences retain close alignment. The main loss after motion prior reconstruction therefore comes from fitting one uninterrupted physical rollout to a sequence of contacts.

With temporal scaling, it leaves the image at the target frame and TE falls from 497.19 to 23.10 pixels. Temporal scaling thus enables Wan-Move to follow the fast motion specified by Stage 6.

With identical point trajectories, full image generation merges the two balls at contact and changes their radius ratio from the simulated value of 0.57 to 1.00. Generation within the interaction ROI preserves a ratio of 0.62.
blocks.zh: 图5 (b)评价接触对中较小物体直径约为13像素时的相互作用ROI. 用相同的点轨迹,完整的图像生成将接触时的两个球合并,并将它们的半径比从模拟值0.57改为1.00. 互动中的生成ROI保持了0.62的比例.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Adaptive temporal scaling and interaction ROI in Stage 7.
blocks.zh: 图5:适应性时间尺度和第七阶段的ROI互动。

blocks.en: Figure 6 shows the edited reference image and projected point trajectories for an Add task.
blocks.zh: 图6显示一项添加任务的编辑参考图像和预测点轨迹。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Object insertion and projected point trajectories in Stage 6.
blocks.zh: 图6:第6阶段的物体插入和预测点轨迹.

blocks.en: C.2.2 Robustness to Incomplete and Ambiguous Observations
blocks.zh: C.2.2 对不完整和含糊观察的强烈性

blocks.en: When observations are incomplete or ambiguous, VideoPhysEdit combines image masks, 3D geometry, support relations, and motion across frames. Stages 2 and 3 use observation confidence and geometric constraints to estimate motion and object placement. Stages 4 and 5 use evidence across time to reconstruct motion and select the physical rollout that best matches the complete sequence. Table 13 summarizes these design choices, followed by examples from canonical frame selection, support plane reconstruction, motion prior reconstruction, and physical inversion.
blocks.zh: 当观测不完整或模棱两可时,VideoPhysEdit结合了图像面具,3D几何,支持关系,以及跨帧运动. 第2阶段和第3阶段使用观测置信度和几何限制来估计运动和物体位置. 第4阶段和第5阶段利用跨时间的证据来重建运动并选择最符合完整序列的物理展开. 表13总结了这些设计选择,然后列举了从犬形框架选择、支持平面重建、运动前重建以及物理倒置等方面的实例。

blocks.en: Table 13 : Handling incomplete and ambiguous observations across the pipeline.
blocks.zh: 表13:处理整个管道的不完整和模棱两可的观察。

blocks.en: Stage 3 Mask IoU measures image alignment after optimizing object pose, scale, and support, but similar image alignment can conceal inconsistent depth and scale. In drop_centered , we change only the canonical frame and compare the resulting 3D scenes. An airborne frame gives a scene Mask IoU of 0.952 but provides no support relation between the ball and the block. After aligning the reconstruction and synthetic ground truth by the block, we normalize each coordinate by the corresponding block dimension. Selecting a stable contact frame gives a similar Mask IoU of 0.969, reduces the normalized 3D ball center error from 2.71 to 0.156, and recovers support relations connecting the floor, block, and ball.
blocks.zh: 第3阶段 IoU在优化对象姿势,规模,支持后测量图像对齐,但类似的图像对齐可以隐藏不一致的深度和尺度. 在drop_central 中,我们只改变犬形框架,并比较由此产生的3D场景. 空降框架给出的场景Mask IoU为0.952,但并未提供球与挡板之间的支撑关系. 在按区块调整重建和合成地面真相后,我们通过相应的区块维度使每个坐标正常化. 选择稳定的接触框会给出相似的Mask IoU 0.969,将正常的3D球中心误差从2.71降至0.156,并恢复连接地板,块,球的支撑关系.

blocks.en: The contact relation constrains relative depth and scale, so the objects occupy consistent positions in the shared world coordinate system. This is why canonical frame selection uses contact evidence in addition to image visibility.
blocks.zh: 接触关系限制了相对深度和规模,因此物体在共享的世界坐标系统中占据了一致的位置. 这就是为什么Cononical框架选择除了图像可见度外还使用接触证据.

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Canonical frame selection in drop_centered . In the 3D views, orange shows the reconstruction and blue wireframes show the aligned ground truth. The red dashed line marks the center error.
blocks.zh: 图 7: Canonical 帧选择在滴_centre_. 在3D视角中,橙色显示重建,蓝线框显示对齐的地面真相. 红色破折线标记了中心错误.

blocks.en: When one physical surface is reconstructed as several support planes, objects on that surface can be assigned different support planes. Figure 8 shows this case in tennis_flight , viewed from above. Stage 3 refits the combined background points of P0, P1, and P4 as one plane and transfers the ball’s support relation to the merged P0. This reduces the active planes from six to three: merging removes two duplicate planes, and candidate P5 is excluded from the physical scene. Stage 3 then places the ball against the refitted plane under the same contact and support constraints.
blocks.zh: 当一个物理表面被重建为数架辅助飞机时,该表面的物体可以被分配不同的辅助飞机. 图8显示在网球_飞行中, 第3阶段将P0,P1和P4的合并背景点重新组合为一个平面,并将球的支持关系转移至合并的P0. 这使得现役飞机从6架减少到3架:合并移除了2架重复飞机,候选P5被排除在物理场景之外. 第3阶段然后将球对准复飞的飞机,置于相同的接触和支持限制之下.

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Support plane reconstruction in tennis_flight . Compatible fragments are refitted as one plane while retaining the ball’s support relation.
blocks.zh: 图8:支持网球飞行中的飞机重建. 兼容的片段在保留球的支撑关系的同时,被重塑为一个平面.

blocks.en: Stage 4 reconstructs motion during gaps in the observations. It fits motion models to stable intervals and connects them with transition curves constrained by boundary states. In picnic_apple_ball , the apple is observed in only 31 of 96 frames. Motion on both sides of each gap constrains a continuous motion prior over the complete video, with a Mask IoU of 0.867 on the observed frames (Figure 9 (a)).
blocks.zh: 第4阶段在观测空白时重建运动. 它适合运动模型稳定间隔,并与受边界状态制约的过渡曲线连接. 在野餐_apple_ball中,苹果仅被观测到96帧中的31帧. 每个空隙两侧的运动会限制在完整视频之前的连续运动,在观测到的框架上有一个0.867的遮罩IoU(图9(a)).

blocks.en: Stage 5 retains up to three candidate simulations while extending evaluation to later stable intervals and transition episodes. Later observations distinguish candidates that fit the early intervals similarly. In ball_block , simulation search and final refinement raise Mask IoU from 0.409 to 0.852 (Figure 9 (b)). Section C.3 evaluates this search across all reconstructed scenes and counterfactual edits.
blocks.zh: 第5阶段保留了最多3次候选人模拟,同时将评价扩大到以后的稳定间隔和过渡阶段。 后来的观察也区分出同样适合早期间隔的考生. 在ball_block中,模拟搜索和最终的精度提升了面具IoU从0.409升至0.852(图9(b)). C.3节评价了这次对所有重建场景的搜索和反事实编辑.

blocks.en: Figure 9 : Motion prior reconstruction and physical inversion. Stage 4 reconstructs motion through missing observations, and Stage 5 improves the physical rollout.
blocks.zh: 图9:先前的重建和物理反演。 第4阶段通过缺失的观测重建运动,第5阶段则改进了物理推出.

blocks.en: C.2.3 Error Analysis
blocks.zh: C.2.3 错误分析

blocks.en:
The examples follow the pipeline from Stage 3 scene reconstruction to Stage 5 physical inversion and Stage 7 video generation.
For two source scenes covering 13 edit tasks, the pipeline produces no valid edited videos, so we use the unchanged source videos as predictions in the complete benchmark evaluation.
blocks.zh:
这些例子包括从第3阶段现场重建到第5阶段物理反演和第7阶段视频生成的管道。
对于涵盖13项编辑任务的两个源场景,管道没有产生有效的经编辑的视频,因此我们使用不变的源场视频作为完整基准评价中的预测.

blocks.en: Figure 10 compares the input observations, Stage 3 projections, and recovered 3D scenes for two reconstruction errors. In bowling , object segmentation assigns spatially separated pins to one identity, so Stage 3 fits one box to two disconnected mask components. Too few 3D correspondences support the resulting pose, and no support plane can be assigned. Colors in the input masks distinguish detected instances; green and red in the projection panels denote observed and projected masks.
blocks.zh: 图10比较了输入观测,第3阶段预测,并恢复了3D场景的两个重建错误. 在保龄球中,物体分割将空间分离的披针分配到一个身份,因此第3阶段将一个盒子匹配到两个断开的面具组件. 支持由此形成的姿势的3D通信太少,无法指定支持平面. 输入口罩中的颜色区分出检测到的情况;投影板中的绿色和红色表示观察到的和投影口罩.

blocks.en: In domino_chain , the object identities are correct, but repeated appearance leaves too few spatially distributed 3D correspondences. One domino therefore has an incorrect pose and extent despite passing the correspondence checks. Thus, one error begins with object identities and the other with unreliable 3D correspondences, both before motion prior reconstruction and physical inversion.
blocks.zh: 在domino_chain 中,对象身份是正确的,但重复的外观留下的空间分布的3D通信太少. 因此,一位多米诺人尽管通过信件核对,但其姿势和程度都不正确。 因此,一个错误开始于对象身份,另一个错误开始于不可靠的3D通信,既在移动前重建,又在物理反演之前.

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Scene reconstruction errors in bowling and domino_chain .
blocks.zh: 图10:保龄球和多米诺链的场景重建错误.

blocks.en: Figure 11 traces two Stage 5 errors to the first contact where each rollout departs from the motion prior. White, cyan, red, and yellow denote observed trajectories, the Stage 4 motion prior, the Stage 5 physical rollout, and inferred contacts; the plots show mean Mask IoU across scene objects. In table_drop_collision , several contact changes share one response window and their impulses cannot be separated. The physical rollout therefore departs immediately after contact, reducing Mask IoU from 0.914 at Stage 4 to 0.192 at Stage 5.
blocks.zh: 图11将两个第5阶段的错误追溯到第一次接触时,每次推出都偏离了之前的运动。 白色、青色、红色和黄色表示观测到的轨迹、第4阶段前运动、第5阶段实际展开和推断接触;图中显示的是横跨场景物体的Mask IoU。 在表格_drop_collision中,多个联系人更改共享一个响应窗口,其冲动无法分离. 因此,在接触后立即开始实际推广,将Mask IoU从第四阶段的0.914减少到第五阶段的0.192。

blocks.en: In air_hockey_chain , object 1 departs after contact C1 and propagates the error to object 3 at C2, while object 2 remains aligned. This example shows how an earlier state error changes a later interaction.
blocks.zh: 在 Air_hockey_chain 中,对象1在接触C1后离开,并在C2时将错误传播给对象3,而对象2仍然对齐. 此示例显示早期状态错误如何改变后期交互.

blocks.en: Figure 11 : Physical inversion errors after contact.
blocks.zh: 图11:接触后物理反演错误.

blocks.en: Figure 12 shows a third physical inversion error in dining_chain . Stage 4 recovers the observed trajectories, but three closely spaced contacts are difficult for Stage 5 to reproduce in one physical rollout. In this case, object 1 remains nearly stationary and object 3 departs from the recovered motion after contact. This error arises from resolving a dense contact sequence rather than from missing image observations.
blocks.zh: 图12显示餐饮链的第三个物理反演错误。 第4阶段恢复了观测到的轨迹,但第5阶段很难在一次物理推展中复制三个紧密的间距接触. 在这种情况下,物体1保持近乎静止,物体3在接触后偏离了已恢复的运动. 这个错误产生于解密的接触序列,而不是缺失的图像观测.

blocks.en: Figure 12 : Physical inversion with closely spaced contacts in dining_chain .
blocks.zh: 图12:在餐饮链中具有紧密间距联系的物理反转。

blocks.en: In pool_collision/edit_add_ball_midway , the Stage 6 placement and trajectories shown in Figure 6 are correct, and the generated video follows the added ball. The existing ball nevertheless deviates from its simulated trajectory after contact, so the error first appears during video generation.
blocks.zh: 在pool_collision/edit_add_ball_midway中,图6中显示的阶段6放置和轨迹正确,生成的视频跟随添加的球. 现有的球在接触后仍然偏离其模拟的轨迹,因此错误在视频生成时首先出现.

blocks.en: Figure 13 shows a second video generation error in ball_carpet_climb/edit_hard_push . Stage 6 produces the intended fast trajectory, and its projected control points leave the image. Stage 7 follows the initial motion but continues to depict a distorted object after the trajectory has left the image. Point trajectories constrain visible motion but do not directly enforce object absence after it exits the view. Together with the insertion example above, this case shows that Stage 6 can specify the intended intervention even when Wan-Move does not fully reproduce it in the final video.
blocks.zh: 图13显示在ball_carpet_climb/edit_hard_push中出现第二个视频生成错误. 第6阶段产生预定的快速轨迹,其预测的控制点离开图像. 第七阶段遵循初始运动,但在轨迹离开图像后继续描绘一个扭曲的物体. 点轨道限制可见运动,但在退出视图后不直接执行对象缺席. 与上面的插入示例一起,这个案例表明,即使万-莫夫没有在最后的视频中完全复制,第6阶段也可以指定预期的干预.

blocks.en: Figure 13 : A video generation error after the Stage 6 trajectory leaves the image.
blocks.zh: 图13:第六阶段轨迹之后的视频生成错误离开图像.

blocks.en: C.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: C.3 读取研究

blocks.en: We evaluate whether simulation search improves the counterfactual trajectories produced by Stage 6. We compare the calibrated initialization with the result after simulation search and final refinement. Both variants use the same edits, Stage 6 operations, matched objects, and evaluation frames; only the Stage 5 physical scene changes. We evaluate Stage 5 on the same reconstructed source scenes as Table 11 and compare Stage 6 on the same objects and frames.
blocks.zh: 我们评价模拟搜索是否改善了第6阶段产生的反事实轨迹. 我们把校准的初始化与模拟搜索和最后改进后的结果进行比较。 两个变体都使用相同的编辑,第6阶段操作,匹配对象,以及评价框架;只有第5阶段物理场景变化. 我们评价第5阶段与表11相同的重建源场景,并比较第6阶段在同一物体和框架上.

blocks.en: Table 14 : Ablation of Stage 5 physical inversion.
blocks.zh: 表14:第五阶段物理反演情况。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 14 , simulation search and final refinement improve all three Stage 6 metrics and reduce TE by 18.7%. The result shows that a more accurate physical rollout of the source video also yields more accurate counterfactual trajectories after physical intervention.
blocks.zh: 如表14所示,模拟搜索和最后改进改进了所有三个阶段6的度量,将TE减少18.7%。 结果显示,更精确的物理推出源视频在物理干预后也会产生更准确的反事实轨迹.

blocks.en: C.4 Runtime and Memory
blocks.zh: C.4 运行时间和内存

blocks.en: Table 15 reports runtime and peak GPU memory by stage. Stages 1 to 5 run once per source video, whereas Stages 6 and 7 run for each edit. The Stage 7 measurement includes the two overlapping Wan-Move windows used to produce each complete video. Stage 1 time and peak memory come from a separate complete run; times for the other stages are averaged over the benchmark runs. Motion fitting in Stage 4 and physical simulation in Stage 5 run on the CPU. The Set operation in Stage 6 also runs on the CPU, while Add and Delete invoke appearance editing models.
blocks.zh: 表15按阶段报告运行时间和GPU内存高峰。 第1至第5阶段每个源视频运行一次,而第6和第7阶段每个编辑运行一次。 第七阶段的测量包括两个重叠的Wan-Move窗口,用于制作每个完整的视频. 第一阶段的时间和峰值记忆来自单独的完整运行;其他阶段的时间平均为基准运行时间. 第4阶段的动作 以及第5阶段的物理模拟 运行在CPU。 阶段6中的Set操作也在CPU上运行,而添加和删除则引用外观编辑模型.

blocks.en: Table 15 : Runtime and peak GPU memory by stage.
blocks.zh: 表15:按阶段分列的运行时间和高峰GPU内存.

blocks.en: C.5 Effect of Explicit Downstream Consequences
blocks.zh: C.5 明显的下游后果的影响

blocks.en: We test whether describing the expected motion helps baselines perform physical edits. For four PCVE-RigidBench tasks, we append a qualitative description of the target motion and interactions to the original quantitative edit instruction. Each baseline uses the same source video and generation settings for both instructions. VideoPhysEdit uses the original instruction.
blocks.zh: 我们测试描述预期运动是否有助于基线进行物理编辑。 对于4个PCVE-Rigid Bench任务,我们附加了对目标运动和相互作用的定性描述到原始的定量编辑指令中. 每个基线都使用相同的源视频和生成设置来进行两种指令. 视频 PhysEdit使用原始指令.

blocks.en: Table 16 : PES with the original physical edit and with explicit downstream consequences appended. Each cell reports original → \rightarrow explicit consequences. † \dagger denotes an invalid track of the evaluated object.
blocks.zh: 表16:PES的原始物理编辑和下游的明确后果。 每个细胞都报告原始的 \\\ 直截了当的明显后果。 ^\dagger 表示被评价对象的无效轨道。

blocks.en: Figure 14 : Effect of explicit downstream consequences on Seedance 2.5 and MiniMax H3. The bold text after each arrow is added to the original edit instruction. Each baseline is evaluated with and without the added text; VideoPhysEdit uses the original instruction. All methods are shown at the same three time points for each task.
blocks.zh: 图14:明确下游后果对种子2.5和MiniMax H3的影响。 每个箭头之后的粗体文字被添加到原始编辑指令中. 每个基准都与添加的文本同时评估; VideoPhysEdit 使用原始指令. 所有方法在每项任务相同的三个时间点上显示.

blocks.en: Figure 15 : Effect of explicit downstream consequences on VACE and Ditto. Tasks, time points, and layout match Figure 14 .
blocks.zh: 图15:明确下游后果对VACE和Ditto的影响。 任务、时间点和布局匹配图14。

blocks.en: Adding the expected consequences does not consistently improve PES across the four tasks (Table 16 ). VACE and Ditto largely preserve the source motion with either instruction. Seedance 2.5 and MiniMax H3 make more visible changes, but these changes often differ from the target motion. MiniMax H3 stops the car on the ramp in the Grippy car example, although the track of the evaluated object is invalid. Figures 14 and 15 show these outcomes. Describing the expected motion alone is therefore insufficient to obtain the target result consistently in these tasks.
blocks.zh: 加上预期后果并不能在四项任务中持续改善生态系统服务支出(表16)。 VACE和Ditto基本上保留了源动,任一指令。 种子2.5和MiniMax H3进行更明显的改变,但这些改变往往与目标运动不同. MiniMax H3在Grippy汽车的例子中停止了斜坡上的车,尽管被评价对象的轨迹无效. 图14和图15显示了这些成果。 因此,仅说明预期动议不足以在这些任务中取得一致的目标结果。

blocks.en: C.6 Additional Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: C.6 其他定性结果

blocks.en: Figure 16 compares VideoPhysEdit with VACE, Ditto, MiniMax H3, and Seedance 2.5 on four additional PCVE-RigidBench edits. The frames are selected around the execution frame, the first interaction, and the resulting motion. The competing methods often retain a removed object or continue the source motion after the requested parameter change. VideoPhysEdit removes the selected object at the specified frame and changes the subsequent motion after edits to friction and mass while preserving the preceding interaction.
blocks.zh: 图16将VideoPhysEdit与VACE,Ditto,MiniMax H3,以及另外4部PCVE-Rigid Bench编辑的种子2.5进行比较. 框架选择围绕执行框架,第一次互动,以及由此产生的运动. 相互竞争的方法往往保留一个被移除的对象,或在请求的参数变化后继续源运动. 视频 PhysEdit在指定框中移除选定的对象,并在编辑后将后续运动更改为摩擦和质量,同时保留之前的相互作用.

blocks.en: Figure 16 : Additional comparisons on PCVE-RigidBench.
blocks.zh: 图16:PCVE-Rigid Bench的其他比较。

blocks.en: Figure 17 : Comparison with VOID on four removal edits applied from the first frame. The top two examples are from PCVE-RigidBench; the bottom two are real videos without paired counterfactual targets. Each row shows the same time point across methods. Crops are fixed within each video and aligned by ruler markings in the last example.
blocks.zh: 图17:与VOID比较从第一个框架应用的4个删除编辑. 上两个例子来自PCVE-Rigid Bench;下两个是没有对对反事实目标的真视频. 每行显示不同方法的相同时点. 作物在每个视频中固定,并在最后一个例子中以标尺标记对齐.

blocks.en: Figure 18 : Additional comparisons on real videos.
blocks.zh: 图18:真实视频的其他比较。

blocks.en: Figure 19 : VideoPhysEdit results for restitution, removal, and insertion edits.
blocks.zh: 图19:用于复原、删除和插入编辑的视频编辑结果。

blocks.en: The top two examples in Figure 17 compare VideoPhysEdit with VOID and the two commercial models on two removal tasks in PCVE-RigidBench. Removing the wooden block allows the basketball to continue across the floor; removing the apple prevents the subsequent displacement of the soccer ball. VideoPhysEdit follows these changes in the target videos, while VOID removes the selected objects but retains substantial motion from the source interaction.
blocks.zh: 图17中前两个例子将VideoPhysEdit与VOID和PCVE-Rigid Bench中两个移除任务的两种商业模型进行比较. 移除木块可以让篮球继续横跨地板;移除苹果可以防止足球随后的转移. 视频 PhysEdit跟随目标视频中的这些变化,而VOID则删除选定的对象,但保留了源交互中的实质性运动.

blocks.en: Before cropping, we restore the source aspect ratio for VideoPhysEdit outputs in the benchmark examples and the VOID output in the ruler example. All other resizing preserves aspect ratio.
blocks.zh: 在裁剪前,我们恢复基准示例中VideoPhysEdit输出和标尺示例中VOID输出的源侧比. 所有其他调整大小都保留了宽比.

blocks.en: The bottom two examples in Figure 17 remove a ball from the first frame in two recorded collision scenes. After removal, the remaining ball should continue its initial motion: the blue ball should keep moving to the right in the tabletop scene, while the small ball should remain at rest in the ruler scene. These real videos have no paired counterfactual targets.
blocks.zh: 图17中最底层的两个例子在两个有记录的碰撞场景中从第一个帧中移除一个球. 移除后,剩余球应继续其初始运动:蓝色球应继续在表盘场景中向右移动,而小球则应留在尺盘场景中休息. 这些真实的视频没有对应的反事实目标.

blocks.en: In the tabletop scene, VideoPhysEdit removes the yellow ball and lets the blue ball continue to the right. VOID also removes the yellow ball, but the blue ball still reverses direction as it does in the source video. MiniMax H3 and Seedance 2.5 show rightward motion after removal, although the blue ball’s position differs from the source before contact.
blocks.zh: 在桌面场景中,VideoPhysEdit移除黄色球,让蓝色球继续右侧. VOID也移除了黄球,但蓝球仍然像源视频中那样逆向. MiniMax H3和种子2.5在切除后显示向右运动,尽管蓝色球的位置与接触前的来源不同.

blocks.en: In the ruler scene, VideoPhysEdit removes the large ball and keeps the small ball at its initial position. VOID removes the large ball, but the small ball still moves. MiniMax H3 removes the large ball but places the small ball farther along the ruler. Seedance 2.5 retains both balls and their collision.
blocks.zh: 在标尺场景中,VideoPhysEdit移除了大球并保持小球的初始位置. VOID移除了大球,但小球仍然移动. 迷你麦克斯 H3移除了大球,但将小球沿标尺更远处放置. 种子2.5保留了球及其碰撞.

blocks.en: Across the four examples, VideoPhysEdit consistently removes the specified object and produces the expected subsequent motion. VOID removes the object but retains motion from the original interaction or introduces movement in an object that should remain at rest.
blocks.zh: 四个例子,视频 PhysEdit一致地去除指定的对象,并产生预期的随后的运动. VOID移除对象,但保留原交互中的运动,或者在应该保持休息状态的对象中引入运动.

blocks.en: Figure 18 presents further real video comparisons for object removal and changes to initial velocity, friction, and mass. The baseline results frequently preserve the original motion or change the scene appearance. VideoPhysEdit instead removes the selected ball while retaining the remaining motion, slows the can on the incline, keeps the ball on the ramp longer after increasing friction, and changes the collision response when either ball becomes heavier or lighter.
blocks.zh: 图18对物体清除和初始速度、摩擦和质量的变化进行了进一步的视频真实比较。 基线结果经常保留原动或改变场景外观. 视频 PhysEdit则在保留剩余运动的同时去掉所选球,将罐头延缓在线条上,使球在摩擦增加后更长时间地留在斜坡上,并在任一球变重或更轻时改变碰撞反应.

blocks.en: Figures 19 and 20 group additional VideoPhysEdit results by source scene. Each framed group shows the source once and uses the same six frames for every derived edit, which makes changes in motion and interaction directly comparable. The domino and bouncing ball scenes contrast multiple interventions applied to the same observation. The remaining examples cover initial velocity, mass, object removal, and insertion. In the insertion example, the added blue stone appears at the requested midpoint and changes the later interaction between the original stones. Together, the examples show that the same pipeline handles Add, Delete, and Set edits across distinct rigid body interactions.
blocks.zh: 图19和图20按源场景分类新增VideoPhysEdit结果. 每个框架组一次显示源,每一次派生编辑都使用相同的六个框架,这可以使运动和交互的变化直接可比. 多米诺和弹球场景对比了适用于同一观测的多种干预. 其余的例子包括初始速度、质量、物体清除和插入。 在插入示例中,添加的蓝石出现在请求的中点,并改变原石之间的后期相互作用. 这些例子一起表明,同一管道处理添加、删除和设置不同僵硬的身体相互作用。

blocks.en: Appendix D Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录D 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: VideoPhysEdit currently targets rigid-body scenes observed by a static camera. It assumes static planar support surfaces and represents object geometry using sphere or box models. The current formulation therefore does not cover camera motion, nonplanar supports, complex object geometry, or articulated and actively controlled agents such as people and robots. Fixed thresholds in observation filtering, geometric fitting, and motion analysis can also be sensitive to scene scale, object size, and observation quality. Future work will extend scene reconstruction and simulation to moving cameras, richer geometry and collision proxies, and articulated or controlled agents, while adapting thresholds to scene scale and observation confidence.
blocks.zh: 视频 PhysEdit目前的目标是静态相机观测到的刚性身体场景. 它假设静态的平面支撑,并使用球体或盒模型代表物体几何. 因此,目前的配方并不涵盖相机运动,非Planar支持,复杂的物体几何,或人和机器人等被明确和积极控制的物剂. 在观测过滤,几何装配,运动分析中的固定阈值也可以对场景尺度,物体大小,观测质量敏感. 今后的工作将扩大场景的重建和模拟范围,使之包括移动相机、更丰富的几何和碰撞代号以及明确或可控制的物剂,同时根据场景尺度和观测信心调整阈值。
